entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A moving rod is observed to have a length of \( \ell = 2.00 \, \text{m} \) and to be oriented at an angle of \( \theta = 30.0^\circ \) with respect to the direction of motion as shown in figure. The rod has a speed of \( 0.995c \).

## Question

What is the orientation angle in the proper frame?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( 2.50^\circ \)

- B: B: \( 2.80^\circ \)

- C: C: \( 3.00^\circ \)

- D: D: \( 3.30^\circ \)

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a rod positioned at an angle above a dashed line. The rod is marked with the length symbol "ℓ", and the angle of inclination from the dashed line is marked as "θ". Below the dashed line, an arrow pointing to the right is labeled "Direction of motion". The arrow indicates the movement direction parallel to the dashed line.

## Dataset metadata

Relativity; Physical Model Grounding Reasoning, Multi-Formula Reasoning
